name: catfish-companion-app
description: Catfish Companion App — desktop sidekick for managing local Catfish components, sessions, and quota

scripts.tauri:build:app: echo '❌ 这条命令已停用 —— 它打出的包不含内嵌运行时(hermes/python/node).' && echo '   按架构选一条: npm run tauri:build:arm64  或  npm run tauri:build:x64' && exit 1
scripts.tauri:build: echo '❌ 这条命令已停用 —— 它打出的包不含内嵌运行时(hermes/python/node).' && echo '   按架构选一条: npm run tauri:build:arm64  或  npm run tauri:build:x64' && exit 1
scripts.tauri:build:arm64: npm run tauri:build:clean && tauri build --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.aarch64.conf.json && bash scripts/verify-app-arch.sh aarch64 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Catfish Companion.app' && bash scripts/sign-app-local.sh 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Catfish Companion.app' && bash scripts/make-dmg.sh
scripts.tauri:build:x64: npm run tauri:build:clean && tauri build --bundles app --target x86_64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.x64.conf.json && bash scripts/verify-app-arch.sh x64 'src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/Catfish Companion.app' && bash scripts/sign-app-local.sh 'src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/Catfish Companion.app' && bash scripts/make-dmg.sh x64
scripts.tauri:build:install: npm run tauri:build:arm64 && npm run tauri:install
